questions.question: Propose a mechanism for the reaction of 2-methylpropene with HBr

points.text: Electrophilic addition. H⁺ adds to less substituted C (Markovnikov) -> more stable 3 deg carbocation (CH₃)₃C⁺. Br⁻ attacks carbocation -> 2-bromo-2-methylpropane. Curly arrows: pi bond to H, H-Br bond to Br
